newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes up at 16-month high vs US dollar.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes up at 16-month high vs US dollar.

text.p: The Chinese yuan breached the key 8.3000 resistance level and closed up at a 16-month high of 8.2988 against the U.S. dollar on Friday from Thursday's 8.3000, traders said.
The new previous high on the Shanghai-based interbank foreign exchange market was 8.2959 set on June 8, 1995.
The yuan opened much higher at 8.2975 and fell to move between 8.2990 and an intra-day low of 8.2995, hitting a high of 8.2974.
Dealers said the yuan stood firmly above 8.30 for the whole session but trading was dull with most done at 8.2985.
"More active buying emerged to push the yuan up after it closed at 8.3000 yesterday because most people wanted to buy at 8.3000, which is thought to be a bottom line," one dealer said.
"The expected intervention from the central bank around 8.30 did not appear, which helped today's rise," a second dealer said.
Dealers expect the yuan to rise further early next week.
The yuan closed slightly up at 7.4550 from 7.4640 against 100 Japanese yen and up at 1.0726 from 1.0735 against the Hong Kong dollar.
